name: LeakWatch
description: LeakWatch teaches you which of your Docker containers should be behind a VPN - and shows you, at a glance, whether they actually are. Building an *arr stack and not sure what needs a VPN? LeakWatch lists every container, tells you whether a VPN is REQUIRED (torrent/usenet), RECOMMENDED (indexers, *arr apps) or NOT NEEDED (Plex, dashboards, databases), and explains WHY in plain language. Then it checks each container's real public IP and flags anything that should be protected but is leaking your server's real IP. Zero configuration: just set the WebUI port and click Apply - everything else is preset. The scan runs automatically when you open the page. For new users it is a guide to safe setup; for experienced users it is a single dashboard to confirm everything is configured as expected and to catch a VPN that silently dropped. How it checks: a throwaway sidecar container runs inside each target's network namespace and reports the real exit IP (works even if the app has no curl/wget), cross-checked across several IP services. It best-effort names the VPN provider (Mullvad, NordVPN, Surfshark, Proton, PIA and more), detects tun/wg tunnels, recognises Tailscale/ZeroTier mesh networks, and includes an IPv6-leak and Tor-exit check. Needs the Docker socket mounted (preset) so it can list and probe your containers. It only reads and tests - it never changes your containers.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Preset. Lets LeakWatch list your containers and run network probes.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Preset. Stores the scan cache (optional - the app works without it too).

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The only setting you need: the port for the LeakWatch web interface.

variables.name: Helper Image
variables.description: Advanced. Tiny image used to probe each container's network namespace.

variables.name: Probe Timeout (s)
variables.description: Advanced. Per-service network timeout in seconds.

variables.name: Scan Concurrency
variables.description: Advanced. How many containers to test in parallel.

variables.name: proxycheck.io API Key (optional)
variables.description: Advanced/optional. Free proxycheck.io key for sharper VPN-provider naming (1000 lookups/day). Works without a key at a lower limit.
